title: Verifier for "A proof of Borcea's quadratic variance conjecture"
description:
Exact replay of the computer-assisted part of the proof of Borcea's quadratic variance conjecture (L. Bouthat and S. Fallat, A proof of Borcea's quadratic variance conjecture, 2026).

Two certificates cover every degree 4 ≤ n ≤ 2047: 150,845 three-parameter regions for degrees 4–26 and 27,429 two-parameter regions for degrees 27–2047. The verifier rebuilds every region from the certificate trees and re-checks each one with directed integer interval arithmetic. Python 3.10 or later, standard library only; run python verify_all.py.
